**Built the lane class in the gates (#905, slice A of #889): issue-link recomputes the lane predicate, lane-paths and lane-scrub as required contexts, the template sentence**

**What**: Added brain/scripts/governance/checks/lane.mjs (classifyLane, pure: branch matches the planner's ref grammar AND every changed file is an added .memory/records/*.jsonl, never index.jsonl; uncomputable means not a lane), the exemption in run-check.mjs runIssueLinkCheck (regex short-circuit before git, three-dot diff, closing keyword and issue lookup skipped only when the predicate holds), two actor-check pins (a lane warns and exits 0; a denied approver still fails), lane-paths.mjs and lane-scrub.mjs (pure cores with seams; both run and pass explicitly on non-lane PRs; scrub scans added records on every PR, prints pattern and line number only, never imports governance-tiers; an unreadable record fails closed as uncomputable), the two jobs registered in GOVERNANCE_JOBS, GATE_MATRIX and governance.yml appended last with no PR_NUMBER in their env, the ripple into the GitLab CI mirror, the scaffold's gate table and both regenerated templates, the e2e fixture and three tests that hardcoded the job array, and the template's memory sentence.

**Why**: Wave 3 slice 3.1c of #864 under ADR-0034 L1/C1/L6 and ADR-0016; the exemption must be safe before the maintainer arms the contexts with brain:protect. Counted ~514 lines: the maintainer chose size:exception because the excess is mechanical regeneration guarded by drift tests and the registration must be atomic.

**Where**: brain/scripts/governance/**, brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs, governance-tiers.mjs, contributor-scaffold.mjs, .github/workflows/governance.yml, brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .gitlab/merge_request_templates/Default.md, test/review-regulated/fixture.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-889-lane-governance/**.

**Learned**: a rename appears in git diff --name-only A...B and not in --diff-filter=A, so the subset conjunction holds (git 2.53). Registering a governance job ripples into five drift-guarded places. A fresh cold review ran thirteen bypass attempts on real three-dot diffs and killed 17 of 17 mutants; the trust boundary of a lane is branch name plus path shape, not identity, and GitLab runners without GIT_DEPTH 0 make three-dot checks uncomputable on every MR.
